message: In Schedule TDS3 the total of column 7 ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the individual values ({{expected}}).

source: Refund claimed should be equal to "Total Taxes Paid" minus "Total Tax and Interest payable".

message: The tax payable ({{payable}}) must equal total tax and interest payable ({{liability}}) minus total taxes paid ({{paid}}).

message: Total TDS claimed ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the TDS claimed in Schedules TDS1, TDS2 and TDS3 ({{expected}}).

message: Total TCS claimed ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the TCS claimed in the TCS schedule ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule TCS so the total is recomputed.
source: In "Schedule Taxes Paid and Verification" Total TCS Claimed should be equal to the sum of total TCS claimed in TCS schedule

message: Total advance tax ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the Schedule IT rows with a date of deposit between {{from}} and {{to}} ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule IT so the challans are reclassified by their date of deposit.
source: In "Schedule Taxes Paid and Verification" Total Advance Tax paid is not equal to the sum of total Tax Paid in schedule IT where date of deposit is between 1/04/20XX and 31/03/20XX of PY for which return is being filed.

message: Total self-assessment tax ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the Schedule IT rows with a date of deposit after {{after}} ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule IT so the challans are reclassified by their date of deposit.

message: Under the old regime the standard deduction u/s 16(ia) is limited to {{limit}}. {{claimed}} has been allowed.

source: In case of Old Tax Regime, taxpayer being an employee can claim Standard deduction u/s 16ia only to the extent of Rs 50000.

message: Credit for TDS has been claimed but the corresponding receipts have not been offered to tax anywhere in the return. Deductor(s): {{deductors}}.
remediation: Offer the corresponding receipts to tax under the relevant head, or remove the TDS credit for {{deductors}}.
source: Credit for TDS has been claimed in the return of income, but the corresponding receipts/income has been omitted to be offered for taxation. (Receipts/ Income should be offered to tax in one or the schedules in the return. Further, receipts as appearing in Form 26AS to be offered to tax in one or the schedules in the return)

message: The maximum deduction allowable u/s 80GG is {{limit}} — the lower of {{flat}} or 25% of total income excluding LTCG before this deduction. {{claimed}} has been claimed.
remediation: Reduce the 80GG claim to {{limit}} or lower.

message: The maximum limit allowable u/s 80CCD(1B) is {{limit}}. {{claimed}} has been claimed.
remediation: Reduce the 80CCD(1B) claim to {{limit}} or lower.

message: ITR-1 cannot be used. Total income excluding LTCG ({{ti}}) exceeds {{limit}} — ITR-2 is required.
remediation: File ITR-2 instead. ITR-1 is available only where total income excluding LTCG does not exceed {{limit}}.

message: Under the old regime, the deduction u/s 80CCD(2) of {{claimed}} exceeds 14% of salary ({{limit}}) where the employer is Central or State Government.
remediation: Reduce the 80CCD(2) claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: In case of Old Tax Regime - Deduction u/s 80CCD (2) should not be more than 14% of salary if any of the employer category is Central Government or state government

message: The deduction claimed u/s 80EE ({{claimed}}) exceeds the maximum limit of {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80EE claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected, then Assessee claiming deduction u/s 80EE more than the maximum limit of Rs 50000/-

message: The deduction claimed u/s 80EEA ({{claimed}}) exceeds the maximum limit of {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80EEA claim to {{limit}} or lower.

message: The deduction claimed u/s 80EEB ({{claimed}}) cannot be more than {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 80EEB claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected, then Assessee claiming deduction u/s 80EEB cannot be more than Rs 150000/-

message: In Schedule 80D the value at field 2b ({{value}}) is greater than {{limit}}.

message: In Schedule 80D the deduction at Sl. No. 2b ({{value}}) must equal the sum of Sl. No. (i + ii + iii) ({{expected}}).

source: In Schedule 80D, Deduction at Sl. No. 2b should be equal to sum of Sl. No (i+ii+iii) Note: This validation to be checked if value of (i+ii+iii) Sl. No. 2b is less than 50000

remediation: Merge the duplicated exempt income rows into a single row per nature of income.
source: Any drop-down of nature of income cannot be selected more than one time under Exempt Income.

message: The exempt allowance u/s 10(10B)(i) and 10(10B)(ii) is not allowed to Central Government employees, State Government employees, CG-Pensioners, SG-Pensioners, PSU-Pensioners or Other Pensioners. {{claimed}} has been claimed.
remediation: Remove the 10(10B) exempt allowance rows, or correct the nature of employment.
source: Exempt Allowance u/s 10(10B) (i) and 10(10B) (ii) Should not be allowed to Central Government employees, state government employees, CG-Pensioners, SG- Pensioners, PSU-Pensioners, or Others-Pensioners

message: The deduction u/s 80CCH ({{claimed}}) must not exceed 46.2% of salary u/s 17(1) ({{limit}}).
remediation: Reduce the 80CCH claim to {{limit}} or lower.
source: Deduction u/s 80CCH should not exceed 46.2% of Salary u/s 17(1)

message: A deduction u/s 80CCH can be claimed only where the nature of employment is 'Central Government' and the age at the date of joining the armed forces is between 17 and 27 years. 80CCH is not allowed for employment category other than 'Central Government'.
remediation: Set the 80CCH claim to 0, or correct the nature of employment and the date of joining the armed forces.
source: Deduction u/s 80CCH can be claimed if Nature of employment is 'Central Government' and age is from 17 years to 27 years as on date of joining of armed forces.

message: The exempt allowance u/s 10(10B) second proviso ({{claimed}}) cannot exceed {{limit}}.
remediation: Reduce the 10(10B)(ii) exemption to {{limit}} or lower.
source: Exempt Allowance u/s 10(10B)-Second proviso- Compensation under scheme approved by the Central Government cannot exceed Rs.500,000

message: Where the return is filed u/s 139(5) and the original return was filed u/s 139(4), the old tax regime cannot be selected.
remediation: Change the response to the opt-out question u/s 115BAC(6) to 'No'.
source: If Return is filed u/s 139(5) and original return was filed u/s 139(4) then Old Tax Regime cannot be selected.

message: The option to withdraw from the new tax regime is not available after the due date of filing the return u/s 139(1) ({{dueDate}}).
remediation: Change the response to the opt-out question u/s 115BAC(6) to 'No'.
source: Option to withdraw from New Tax Regime is not available after due date of filing of return as mentioned u/s 139(1)

message: Under the new tax regime a rebate u/s 87A is not available where total income excluding LTCG ({{ti}}) is more than {{limit}}. A rebate of {{rebate}} has been computed.
remediation: The rebate, with marginal relief, reduces to nil at this income level. Verify the total income figure.
source: If New tax Regime is selected, Rebate u/s 87A is claimed by Resident Individual having Total income excluding LTCG of more than Rs.12,70,590.

message: Under the old tax regime a rebate u/s 87A can be claimed only to the extent of {{limit}} by a resident individual having a total income of {{ceiling}} or less. {{rebate}} has been computed.
remediation: Re-open the Tax Liability screen so the rebate is recomputed.
source: Rebate u/s 87A can be claimed to the extent of Rs.12500 by Resident Individual having Total income of Rs. 5,00,000 under old tax regime

message: A deduction u/s 80GGC of {{claimed}} has been claimed under Chapter VI-A; the same amount and details must be provided in Schedule 80GGC (eligible amount {{eligible}}).
remediation: Complete Schedule 80GGC so that the eligible amount is at least {{claimed}}, or reduce the 80GGC claim.
source: If 80GGC is claimed in Income Details Deduction under Chapter VIA, then same amount and details should be provided in Schedule 80GGC

message: In Schedule 80GGC the eligible amount of contribution for each row must equal the contribution in other mode, to the extent of Gross Total Income. Expected {{expected}}, computed {{eligible}}.
remediation: Re-open Schedule 80GGC so the eligible amounts are recomputed.
source: In Schedule 80GGC, 'Eligible amount of contributions' for each row shall be equal to "contribution in other mode" to the extent of Gross total income

message: In Schedule 80GGC the total contribution ({{total}}) must equal the sum of 'Contribution in cash' ({{cash}}) and 'Contribution in other mode' ({{other}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule 80GGC so the totals are recomputed.
source: Total Contribution' should be equal to sum of "Contribution in cash" AND "Contribution in other mode" in table (80GGC)

message: In Schedule 80GGC, Sl. No. D 'Eligible amount of contribution' ({{total}}) must equal the sum of the individual amounts restricted to Gross Total Income ({{expected}}).
remediation: Re-open Schedule 80GGC so the eligible amount is recomputed.
source: In schedule 80GGC, Sl no. D "Eligible Amount of contribution" should be equal to sum of individual amounts restricted to GTI

message: In Schedule 80GGC the values at Sl. No. A (total contribution in cash), B (contribution in other mode) and C (total contribution) must each equal the sum of the individual amounts entered.
remediation: Re-open Schedule 80GGC so the totals are recomputed.
source: In schedule 80GGC, Values at sl.no.A - total contribution in Cash, B-contribution in other mode and C-Total contribution should be equal to sum of individual amounts entered

message: The date of contribution is mandatory for every contribution made u/s 80GGC.
remediation: Enter the date of contribution for every row in Schedule 80GGC.
source: Date of contribution is mandatory for contribution made under 80GGC

message: Details of the contribution made in a mode other than cash are required in Schedule 80GGC. Only contributions in a mode other than cash are eligible u/s 80GGC.

source: Details of contribution made in other mode are required in schedule 80GGC

message: In Schedule 80U, where the nature of disability is 'self with severe disability' the amount of deduction must be exactly {{expected}} (subject to Gross Total Income). {{claimed}} has been entered.
remediation: Set the Schedule 80U amount to {{expected}}.
source: If Old Tax Regime is selected, And In the schedule 80U value at i- 'Nature of disability' is selected as "self with severe disability" and the value at field ii-'Amount if deduction' is less or more than 125,000 subject to GTI.
